name: Jianchangnathus
sum: Scaphognathus-like long-tailed pterosaur from the Middle–Late Jurassic Tiaojishan Formation of Liaoning, China.
holotype: IVPP V16866 — Tiaojishan Formation, Linglongta, Jianchang County, Liaoning.
material: Skeleton with articulated skull; second specimen PMOL-AP00028 (skull and fragments, subadult).
exceptional: Undescribed referred fossils suggest brown pycnofibres.
biology: High front end of the lower jaw and forward-pointing front teeth; ecology not specifically studied.
author: Cheng et al. 2012

species.name: Jianchangnathus robustus
species.author: Cheng et al. 2012
species.ref: X. Cheng, X. Wang, and S. Jiang, A. W. A. Kellner. 2012. A new scaphognathid pterosaur from western Liaoning, China. Historical Biology 24(1):101-111
